title: Duplicate how-it-works headings confuse path
summary: Repeated 'How It Works' headings create identical-looking entry points, confusing the user's path.
problem: Repeated 'How It Works' headings create identical-looking entry points, confusing the user's path.
evidence: A section heading reads “How It Works”.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

title: Competing CTAs split focus
summary: Multiple CTAs with no hierarchy create choice overload and dilute the primary conversion path.
problem: Multiple CTAs with no hierarchy create choice overload and dilute the primary conversion path.
recommended_change: cta: Single primary CTA: CHECK MY COVERAGE; notes: Secondary actions as subtle links.
evidence: CHECK COVERAGE | CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS | SEE MY OPTIONS | GET STARTED | START CHAT | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE | 7 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “CHECK COVERAGE”, “CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS”, “SEE MY OPTIONS”, “GET STARTED”, “START CHAT”, “SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR”, “CHECK MY COVERAGE”.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

title: Duplicate forms create dead ends
summary: Multiple identical CONTINUE forms on the same page create ambiguity about which form advances the funnel and risk duplicate submissions.
problem: Multiple identical CONTINUE forms on the same page create ambiguity about which form advances the funnel and risk duplicate submissions.
recommended_change: cta: Single CONTINUE form; notes: Only one submission path per view.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

title: Ambiguous CONTINUE button labels
summary: The submit button labeled only CONTINUE fails to communicate the next step, increasing cognitive effort at the interaction point.
problem: The submit button labeled only CONTINUE fails to communicate the next step, increasing cognitive effort at the interaction point.
recommended_change: cta: Check My Coverage; notes: Descriptive action label.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

title: Pricing shown before qualification
summary: Displaying prices before coverage confirmation creates premature commitment barriers and confusion about applicable plans.
problem: Displaying prices before coverage confirmation creates premature commitment barriers and confusion about applicable plans.
recommended_change: notes: Sequence qualification before pricing or label as examples.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

title: Price inconsistencies across pages
summary: Inconsistent price formatting and values across pages undermine trust in quoted costs.
problem: Inconsistent price formatting and values across pages undermine trust in quoted costs.
evidence: Prices shown on the page: $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95/Mo $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95 | Prices shown on the page: $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95/mo $0.00 $99.95 $99.99
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

title: Coverage claims lack verification detail
summary: Unsubstantiated coverage claims without a visible coverage map or verification explanation undermine trust in the coverage-check funnel.
problem: Unsubstantiated coverage claims without a visible coverage map or verification explanation undermine trust in the coverage-check funnel.
recommended_change: cta: CHECK MY COVERAGE; notes: Add coverage map and explanation of verification.
